The blueprint is the detailed reference behind the [paper](paper/index.qmd). It follows the theory
note
[`doc/theory/exact-front.md`](https://github.com/aquemy/ZenoSolver/blob/master/doc/theory/exact-front.md)
statement by statement. For each node it gives the statement, the note's proof (collapsed), the
remarks around it, and the Lean declarations of `lean/ZenoFront` that formalise it, with a link to
their exact source lines. Statements and proofs are cut out of the note, and listings out of the
Lean sources, when the site is built, so neither can drift from the repository.

Every node has two badges:

- **Lean.** [machine-checked]{.badge .ok} when every declaration that formalises the whole
  statement is a theorem whose axioms are among `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`
  (read from `collectAxioms`, the check behind `#print axioms`); [Lean definition]{.badge .ok} for
  definitions; [informal]{.badge .informal} when the statement is not in Lean, possibly with
  formalised parts listed under it. A node is never badged above what its own declarations cover.
- **Note.** [proof in the note]{.badge .informal} for a complete written proof,
  [sketch]{.badge .informal}, [computed]{.badge .informal}, [open problem]{.badge .open},
  [refuted]{.badge .refuted} or [definition]{.badge .informal}, from the status table of §0 of the
  note.

{{< include _blueprint-stats.md >}}
